recentItems.title: Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance - Official Insect Glaive Weapon Breakdown Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out this weapon breakdown trailer for the Insect Glaive in Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance, the upcoming DLC expansion to Capcom's latest Monster Hunter title! 
Promising acrobatic multihitting strikes that allow you to stay close to your prey while dishing out the damage, evading their strikes, the Insect Glaive is perfect for Hunters who want mobility with their damage! 

Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance launches on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

recentItems.title: Marvel's Wolverine - Official Live-Action Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss this live-action trailer for Marvel's Wolverine! Unleash the rage and slash through enemies with Wolverine's signature claws in this all new action game developed by Insomniac Games. 

Marvel's Wolverine launches on PlayStation 5 (PS5) September 15th.

recentItems.description: Check out the Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX announcement trailer for this upcoming RPG card game. Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX, featuring modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era. Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and Steam on February 16, 2027.

recentItems.title: iPhone Duo Foldable Revealed by Apple - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Apple finally joined the foldable phone trend with the announcement of the iPhone Dup, the company's first foldable smartphone. When folded, Apple claims it's about the size of a passport, and unfolded it measure around 7 1/2 inches across. The smallest storage capacity available is 256GB that starts at $1999, and goes all the way to 2TB at $3199. The iPhone Duo will officially be available on October 23rd. In other news, PlayStation Plus subscribers have a new batch of games available this month, including Ball x Pit, Date Everything! and Metro Redux, among others. And finally, a new collab is coming to Skyrim in the form of the Kallax storage unit. And it's not just a piece of furniture, it's a sentient companion that's voiced by What We Do In the Shadows' Matt Barry.

recentItems.title: Danganronpa 2x2 - Official Release Date Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026
recentItems.description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Danganronpa 2x2, an anime detective mystery visual novel developed by Gemdrops. Players will survive a deadly game by Monokuma on Jabberwock Island to determine who's responsible for a sinister situation. Danganronpa 2x2 is launching on January 14, 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

recentItems.title: Palia - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026
recentItems.description:
Here's a look at the Nintendo Switch 2 Announcement Trailer for Palia, the hit free-to-play life simulation adventure RPG developed by Singularity 6 Corporation. Players can enjoy the world of Palia on the go with Nintendo Switch 2, packed with enhanced performance, richer visuals, Joy-Con 2 mouse control, and more. The upcoming Echo Expeditions is also coming to Palia in Holiday 2026 for Nintendo Switch 2.

recentItems.title: Digger - Official Final Trailer (2026) Tom Cruise, Riz Ahmed, Aetheria Angel, John Goodman
recentItems.description:
Check out the Final Trailer for Digger, an upcoming comedic film distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures. The fate of the world lies with Digger, in theaters on October 2.

The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

Digger stars Tom Cruise, Riz Ahmed, Aetheria Angel, John Goodman, Robert John Burke, James Dryden, Kenton Craig, Emma D'Arcy, Agota Dunai, and more. The film is directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu and written by Sabina Berman, Alexander Dinelaris, and Nicolas Giacobone.

Digger is in theaters on October 2.
